edges.reason: msg.sender is passed directly to _setupRole inside initialize, granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE to the caller; the initializer is only guarded against re-invocation, so a front-run of initialize hands full control to an arbitrary account
msg.sender reaches _grantRole through _setupRole, directly writing membership of privileged roles without any authorization check
safeMint is protected by the onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) modifier which checks the caller against MINTER_ROLE
pause is protected by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE)
unpause is protected by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE)
_authorizeUpgrade is protected by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE), controlling who may upgrade the proxy

the caller-supplied newImplementation address is passed into upgradeTo and then into the upgrade authorization path, so an attacker controlling this value could swap in arbitrary logic if authorization is bypassed
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade and executing arbitrary data
upgradeTo delegates the storage-slot update and rollback test to _upgradeToAndCallSecure
upgradeToAndCall delegates the storage-slot update and rollback test to _upgradeToAndCallSecure
_upgradeToAndCallSecure writes the new implementation address via _setImplementation
_upgradeToAndCallSecure performs the setup/rollback calls through _functionDelegateCall
_functionDelegateCall executes a raw delegatecall on the target with caller-influenced data; if the upgrade path is not strictly authorized this gives full control of the proxy storage and funds
the isTopLevelCall local flag in the initializer modifier decides whether the one-time initialization state is written, gating initialize
the recipient parameter of safeMint is forwarded to _safeMint
safeMint calls the internal _safeMint helper
_safeMint performs the actual state mutation through _mint before the receiver callback
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which makes an external call to the recipient contract during minting

the recipient contract's onERC721Received is invoked before _tokenIdCounter.increment() in safeMint, so a malicious recipient can re-enter safeMint and mint multiple tokens with the same id / manipulate the counter
safeMint reads and later increments the _tokenIdCounter state variable
burn validates approval and then calls the internal _burn implementation
the tokenId parameter of burn is used for the _isApprovedOrOwner authorization check before burning
the local owner variable is used to decrement the owner balance inside _burn, an unchecked balance mutation point
the tokenId parameter is used to look up the stored token URI
initialize grants the initial roles through _setupRole which calls _grantRole

normalization_plan.reason: the to parameter only exists as the recipient for the safeMint logic and has no independent behavior, so it is folded into safeMint
the newImplementation parameter is only consumed by the upgrade authorization path and is normalized into _authorizeUpgrade
the token id parameter is only meaningful for the burn authorization and destruction flow
the token id parameter is only used for the metadata lookup and is normalized into tokenURI
the local flag only services the initializer guard of initialize and carries no standalone semantics
the local owner variable only supports the balance mutation inside _burn and is merged into it
